pages.title: Cape Replacement
pages.text: You can give your character a fully custom cape — either a still image or a looping animated video! Just drag an image or video file into the game window while in the right view, and your new cape appears on your back instantly.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Open your inventory (default key $(key)E$()).$(br2)$(bold)2.$() Switch to third-person view (default $(key)F5$()) so you can see your character's back.$(br2)$(bold)3.$() Drag an image or video file into the game window and let go.$(br2)$(note)Both conditions must be met at the same time: inventory open AND third-person view active. Dropping in first-person won't work.$()

pages.title: Supported Formats
pages.text: $(bold)Still cape (no extra mods needed):$()$(br)png, jpg, jpeg, and other common image formats.$(br2)$(bold)Animated video cape (requires NarutoLoading):$()$(br)mp4, gif, mkv, webm, avi, mov, flv, m4v$(br2)$(note)If you drop a video file but NarutoLoading isn't installed, DragIt will try to use it as a still image instead.$()

pages.title: Animated Capes
pages.text: Video capes loop continuously while you're in the world. The animation runs smoothly and all resources are cleaned up automatically when you leave.$(br2)Swapping to a new video cape also properly stops the old one first, so there are no performance issues from switching.

pages.title: Server Sync
pages.text: $(bold)Still capes:$() The image is shared with all online players and saved to the world, so new players joining will see your cape too.$(br2)$(bold)Video capes:$() Only the file path is shared. Other players need to have the $(bold)same video file at the same path$() on their own computer to see the animation.
